topic: Among adults hospitalized with COVID-19, what source-reported all-cause mortality data are available for intravenous remdesivir plus standard care compared with placebo or standard care without remdesivir?

pico.comparison: Placebo or standard care without remdesivir for the primary contrast

targets.comparison: Intravenous remdesivir plus standard care versus placebo or standard care without remdesivir

timepoint_policy.rule: Capture every final source-reported all-cause mortality window, preserving exact duration and in-hospital or post-randomization scope.

extraction_notes: Extraction records source numbers and metadata only. Effect calculation belongs to the calculator and selection belongs to the analysis task.
source_constraints: Do not substitute values from the target review.
Do not silently relabel a remdesivir-duration comparison as a no-remdesivir comparison.
Do not silently replace an analysis denominator with the randomized denominator.
Preserve a possible overlap with WHO Solidarity as an explicit provenance field; overlap resolution belongs to analysis.

target_compatibility.reason: All target families have an existing v1 template.

analysis_profile.scope: One prespecified aggregate-data synthesis from source-derived extractor-plus-calculator candidates

selection_rules: Require a direct randomized remdesivir versus no-remdesivir comparison with deaths and denominators in both arms.
For a study that reports multiple planned remdesivir durations against the same eligible control, select the 10-day regimen; retain the other duration as an unselected candidate.
Exclude an active remdesivir-duration comparison because its comparator receives remdesivir.
Exclude a record whose final mortality table uses post-randomization arm reassignment or altered arm denominators without a source-reported intention-to-treat mortality record.
When a parent WHO Solidarity mortality comparison and a constituent Solidarity subtrial both appear, retain the parent comparison and exclude each overlapping subtrial record.
Do not use target-review effects, target-review counts, or labels that encode these decisions.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
Timepoint eligibility: Use each source-defined mortality window without converting in-hospital and fixed-day follow-up into a common artificial timepoint.
Do not substitute values from the target review.
Do not silently relabel a remdesivir-duration comparison as a no-remdesivir comparison.
Do not silently replace an analysis denominator with the randomized denominator.
